address: 6008 W Broad St, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews: I’ve been a customer for a couple years now. I really love the amount of beer options/flights, they’re rotated frequently. Though I think very few are actually made in house. The menu is more of a Vietnamese fusion cuisine meets bar food. My favorite dishes are the shrimp banh mi (you can tell the bread is fresh) and the noodle bowls. I’ve tried other menu items but nothing noteworthy. They often have events which can be a plus for some interested or a con for those wanting to dine in showing up on one of those days by coincidence. The service can be pretty hit or miss as well, but I’ve never had an overall bad experience. They have games to play as well but I’ve never wanted to deal with the hassle of breaking bills at a busy bar.

fantastic brewery with amazing food and a cool vibe.  I forgot to take a picture of the banh mi because I ate it too fast, but high quality.  fried dumplings were crispy and savory.  wake n shrimp rice bowl hit the spot.  I'm a stout head and they did not disappoint.  took 2 visits to try it all.  they have guest taps from Perennial and Prarie, 2 of my favorite breweries, but their own stouts managed to even top those.  I had never heard of this place before this weekend but they belong on a short list of the best breweries in the US.  if this place was near my home I would be here at least weekly.
Super cool bar with an arcade in the back which was a nice touch. Tasty selection of beers as well as delicious bar food with a Vietnamese twist.

First time visiting The Answer after several years and the beer was still great, the service was good but the food was not at all what I remember. I ordered the pork dumplings and they were really under seasoned and lacking flavor. I also got the pork belly banh mi and while the pork belly was crispy, the whole thing was really under seasoned and lacking salt. Maybe it was just an off day but I was disappointed.

We got the Banh Mi shrimp sandwich and the pork fried rice bowl.  Both were tasty but the sandwich was amazing, especially the bread.  We also got two flights and were impressed by the selection and variety of different and delicious beers on the menu.  My husband especially enjoyed the German Chocolate Cake beer and the Red and Blue Triple Puffsicle, both very flavorful and unique beers!
customer_insights: The Answer Brewpub offers a vibrant atmosphere with a unique Vietnamese fusion menu and a diverse selection of beers. While the food quality can vary, the overall experience is enjoyable, especially for groups looking for a lively night out.

address: 1911 W Main St Suite A, Richmond, VA 23220, USA
googleReviews: This place is a dump.  Showed up at noon on a Sunday for a bite to eat and had to wait too long for service and it wasn't busy. I went to wash my hands before ordering/eating only to find a disgustingly filthy and smelly men's room.  No thanks.  My beer arrived and I'd already decided not to eat here as the general rule is if te bathroom is filthy, so is the kitchen. Oh, and the girl behind the bar added 20% gratuity for a party of one. When I asked why she said "It's and event day."  Apparently if there's a sport being broadcast on the TV it's an "event."  I generally tip out at 25-30% so she cheated herself.  Screw this dump.

I usually enjoy the food and service at Sky Box, which is why I recommended my friend join me for steak night. Unfortunately, this visit was beyond disappointing.

From the start, the short server with black/brown hair came off unwelcoming and downright rude. When we voiced our concerns to the manager, we were told she was the owner’s niece and that “that’s just how they operate.” Not exactly the customer service you expect when bringing someone for their first experience.

The menu doesn’t even bother asking how you’d like your steak cooked beyond “pink or no pink.” My friend requested well-done and I asked for pink — yet both steaks came out practically moo’ing. Raw, undercooked, and completely unappetizing. When we brought it up, we were met with more dismissive responses instead of any attempt to fix it.

At that point, we paid the bill, left the steaks and sides and walked out. Sadly, the nightmare didn’t end there — the next morning I had to take my friend to urgent care to treat food poisoning from that meal.

This was easily the worst dining experience I’ve had at Sky Box. Between the rude staff, the lack of care in preparing food safely, and the dismissive management, I cannot recommend steak night to anyone.

Came the other night and had so much fun! Vibe was awesome and music was all my favorites. All the bartenders were so nice but BRITT?! Hello. I think I’m in love with her. So nice and cute and made the best drinks. Put that girl on a poster or something.

Britt was awesome! Played great day time music and was quick to make sure the game we preferred was on the nearest tv to us. She had overall great energy with a bit of wit & banter that you enjoy from a bartender.

(Edit: with the reply, don't worry, i have words for "crawl with us" as well. This bar was SO FAR from all the other ones, we all got ubers to go to this one that we wernt allowed in at. if someone couldn't do both nights, they should have done NO nights.)
---‐-------------------

So, someone in managment signed up 2 nights to be part of a bar crawl program that lasted till 12. At 11 they started turning people away and claimed "they didnt know about this" even tho this is end end of the SECOND night. So they had been letting people in for this entire time then pretended they didnt know anything about it so they could charge $30 cover.

How do i know someone in managment knew? Because there was a free drink trade in for this specific location. Which had to be communicated to the bartenders from...you guessed it, management.

THEN they tried to claim "oh it was 12, then the clock rolled back to 11" LMAO DAYLIGHT SAVINGS ISNT TILL 2AM.

theres so many bars in richmond that dont have an insane $30 entry. When telling local friends about this, they were bewildered that if there is a cover charge at all, it shouldn't so absurdly high. (Accrording to reply this was their own event that was double booked, so idk if this is the usual cover charge, i sure hope not)
customer_insights: Skybox has a mixed reputation, with some patrons enjoying the lively atmosphere and friendly bartenders, while others report poor service and cleanliness issues. The venue seems to attract a younger crowd looking for a fun night out, especially on event days, but concerns about food safety and management practices have been raised.

address: 2813 Hathaway Rd, Richmond, VA 23225, USA
googleReviews: Great atmosphere. Amazing dive bar. Low priced drinks and meals. Amazing staff. Jenna Westbrook, mgr, is superb. Great attention to a newbie. Location allows indoor smoking, plenty of dart boards and food/drink specials. Met some of the regulars and found out everyone knew each other and they were all regulars. I was the new "kid" on the block but was welcomed and the "family" vibes were there.. I engaged with a lot of the patrons and they are chill and laid back. I recommend this place for a low key date night or just a hangout.

Great spot for darts and drinks. Staff is friendly and prices are very reasonable. For this not being an actual pizza place, the pies are really good. Lots of TVs if you're trying to watch a game too. Dart boards are well maintained and the lighting is good too. Definitely a great place to hang out.

I love this place! The food is amazing! The drinks are great, too. Savannah and Stephanie took great care of my friend and I. Will be returning! Cant wait to try the pizza!! If  I could give it 6 stars, I would!

While looking for late night bar entertainment, I along with other colleagues arrived promptly at 1am. The online and physical signage posted on the door states this bar would be open until 2am. Upon arrival, we were met with a locked door and no staff greeting after knocking for at least 10 mins. There was a semi full bar and staff walking around and still no greetings at the locked doors. We would have appreciated at least being turned away with reason but this has truly put a bad representation for this local establishment.
Savannah is an asset to this establishment.  I have been coming here for years.  Her, Jenna, Don and Stephanie make this place feel like a second home.  Thank you to my rock falls family!
customer_insights: Rock Falls Tavern is a welcoming dive bar known for its friendly atmosphere and low-priced drinks and meals. Patrons appreciate the casual vibe, dart boards, and the sense of community among regulars, making it a great spot for a laid-back night out.

address: 5203 Hatcher St, Richmond, VA 23231, USA
googleReviews: Pizza was very cheesy but still very good, customer service was great, wine was wining. Definitely would return with a group of friends and indulge in their big facility. 8/10 🎀

What an amazing brewery. The pizza was phenomenal and the beer was as good as I'd been told it'd be. The dark Czech was a standout for me and I appreciate the employee who walked me through all the different IPAs and let me sample a few for free before making a decision.

In nicer weather the exterior seating looks like it'd be lovely too. Everything was clean and despite being busy it wasn't too loud. Ample parking on site as well.

My only gripe was the limited to-go options. They had so many beers I really liked but only 5 to go when I visited.

Definitely worth checking out if you're in town and also on my list of places to return to!

My husband, Justin, and I rented Triple Crossing for our wedding reception last November, and it was nothing short of incredible! We were looking for an industrial space that we could transform into our own with a Wes Anderson-inspired tropical vision, and it absolutely delivered. Chelsea and Dani were amazing to work with, and their on-site team was so accommodating on our big day. The space was the perfect size for our 100-person guest count, and we had an absolute blast with a pizza buffet, live band, photo booth, and temporary tattoo bar. Our friends and family are still raving about the appetizers, wood-fired pizzas, and—of course—the Falcon Smash!

Fantastic spot! Great venue, solid beer, amazing people, epic pizza.

Seriously the honey hit pepperoni is the best pizza I have ever had. 🙌
Fulton is a regular for us after our rides on the Capital Trail, so we decided to spend Valentines there as well! Excellent pizza as always and the Valentines menu was a great addition
customer_insights: Triple Crossing Beer - Fulton is a vibrant brewery known for its delicious wood-fired pizzas and a wide selection of craft beers. The venue offers a great atmosphere for groups and is suitable for various occasions, from casual hangouts to special celebrations.

venueName: Basic City Beer Co. Southside RVA
address: 212 W 6th St, Richmond, VA 23224, USA
googleReviews: Really cool joint. Great atmosphere, seems like it was an old industrial building back in the day. Beautiful exposed brick and machinery from back in this buildings hay day. Beer was wonderful, American IPA that is not overly hopped but still has some good bitterness to it. Parking seems like it might be tough if it gets busy but was perfectly fine when was there.
Great beer, easy access. Why sitting at home when you could be here?!

My favorite brewery in Richmond, hands down.
Curtis and Sara are incredible owners who create a welcoming atmosphere — the kind of place where you walk in and instantly feel like you're among friends.

They offer an impressive variety of beers: IPAs, DIPAs, sessions, lagers, and imperials. My go-to is the 6th Lord — a perfect daily drinker.

The space is huge, making it ideal for group hangouts or just a chill night with a couple of friends. It’s also kid-, dog-, and bike-friendly, with a game room tucked in the back to keep everyone entertained.

And if you're hungry? Their pizzas are legit.

Highly recommend. See you there!

Been a year of coming in. People are always good. Beer is always fresh. Things are straightforward and you can meet friends just by being you. The speciality beers that rotate are better than you’d imagine. I’d say go towards medium to fuller body brews and keep your dog ready for treats.

I really enjoy the food and FOH staff, and probably everyone and everything there minus the head pizza guy. This review is solely because of him because I go here every so often for events, trivia, and just to hang out with friends. I dont understand his problem with me but he continues to go out of his way to be a completely and utterly rude, aggressive, drunk old man. If I try to bus my own pizza tray, he rips it out of my hands. Ive helped a dnd event where he kept asking me why I was there and how we didnt need 3 people to host the event...? Im sorry im contributing to the establishment by buying pizza. I feel very uncomfortable when he is around, he is always staring so aggressively. Drinks on the job constantly so maybe thats why? Very miserable old man  whatever the case. I really hate going to Basic City because of this specific individual so no more!
customer_insights: Basic City Beer Co. Southside RVA is a casual brewery with a welcoming atmosphere, perfect for group hangouts and dog-friendly outings. While the beer selection is highly praised, the venue has occasional service issues, particularly with one staff member, which may affect the overall experience.

address: 5 S 20th St, Richmond, VA 23223, USA
googleReviews: Found this gem while looking for a brewery that was open early on a Sunday, and had food. Mostly indoor seating, but it's a lovely space looking into the brewery. Staff was excellent in explaining the brewery history, the beers and the food. We ordered all the apps and enjoyed them all. Then we got a little creative and ordered the chicken strips to tear up and put on their mushroom pizza, as they don't offer additional proteins or toppings. Both were excellent. Only downfall was parking, but we did see something down the alley that may have been for the brewery.

This is a really good brewery. Their selection is slightly limited, but the quality is not. Their “German” style beers are wonderful. They have lPA’s and sours as well. They’re just not my cup of tea 😉

My daughter and I had some time to waste prior to an appointment and we stumbled upon Richbrau Brewing and I am so glad we did!  I had the Richbrau Lager and Psychic Horse; both were really good and hit the spot. We didn't grab a bite to eat as we had dinner reservations elsewhere, but from the look and smells of those around us who were eating, I definitely want to come back and try some pizza!

The atmosphere is relaxing and laid back. They have a patio area where you can sit and enjoy a cold one or inside their spacious interior. There is a small selection of board games to play and sports on the tv. Not too loud, friendly staff and great beer - who could ask for anything more!
Love this place.  The beer is both creative and brewed to perfection.  The staff is always friendly and helpful.  Plenty of games and nice vibe inside.  Really can’t recommend enough.

The beer is excellent.
The staff is warm and kind.
The décor is rustically charming.
In a world with too many beers that are hop-monsters or ABV queens, Richbrau's beer offerings are stunningly balanced. Whether their style of beer is to your liking or not (it is definitely to mine), you will respect the products. They make interesting beer. If I lived in closer than 100 miles, this would be a regular joint for me.

The DDH Dapper Thief DIPA is on my short list of most interesting beers I have had all year.
customer_insights: Richbrau Brewing offers a relaxed atmosphere with a focus on quality craft beers and a limited but well-executed food menu, including pizza and appetizers. The friendly staff and inviting space make it a great spot for casual gatherings, pregame meetups, or simply enjoying a laid-back afternoon with friends.

address: 147 Monroe Church Rd, Rice, VA 23966, USA
googleReviews: From the amazing staff, to the delicious cocktails (get the Notorious F.I.G!!) and tasty pizza ... this place has it all!  Awesome setting & scenery too - 5 ⭐ experience

My wife and I stopped here on a whim while traveling home from a weekend trip. This place is simply amazing! The location is very peaceful and calming. Had a tasting of all the bourbons and was very surprised at how good they were for being aged 2-4 years. The smoked old fashioned was incredible as well. Don’t skip out on the pizza as it’s out of this world. We will definitely come back and bring the kids next time as there is so much to do. Great experience!

My husband, son and I all came to celebrate a late Father’s Day due to booking constraints (so book in advance). What an amazing family experience from the outdoor course to the distillery afterwards. Take the time to invest in familial experience and a great drink and laugh afterwards with Shannon and the crew. Had a favorite dirty martini made by Miss Shannon in the distillery and it was aesthetically pleasing and yummy to boot! Thank you to the staff that were friendly, patient and well educated in their fields from the outdoor course to making a beautifully delicious drink! Yall rock!

Lot's of fun for children here. The crabs were amazing! They bring them out in buckets and you eat them at the table covered with brown paper. The distillery has glass windows so you can see the equipment they use to make various libations.

My experience here was wonderful and given the atmosphere of this place it was a place you can expect to just forget about the world around you as you sit on the tables they have in the patio. Staff is nice and understanding and they can make you feel that your heard and safe as you enjoy burning time with the options they have to offer. Its just one of those places you can escape from things and simply breath in everything. Time is your friend here especially when you bring a crowd or some friends memories will be burned into your mind as you enjoy doing nothing but eating food, sipping drinks, and being away from the every day life.
customer_insights: Sandy River Distillery offers a relaxed and family-friendly atmosphere with a focus on bourbon tastings and delicious pizza. Guests appreciate the scenic outdoor setting and friendly staff, making it a great spot for casual gatherings and special occasions.

address: 2910 W Leigh St, Richmond, VA 23230, USA
googleReviews: We love this place, but I have to say our visits went from like 6 times in one year to only 1 time since they stopped contracting with KoBop. I have no idea who initiated the end of that relationship, however it made Busky Cider my favorite go-to place with friends. We introduced several people to Busky who also loved the Busky-KoBop combo but haven’t gone back since it ended. Regardless, it’s a nice cidery with yummy flavors, fun flights, games available and alcoholic ice cream. It’s just not the same without the amazing food! If you ever have the chance to work with KoBop again, please know you’d have a LOT of eager people returning!

Went to Buskey Cider with my friend and we loved it!! The best cidery in Richmond. Our favorite cider was Watermelon Rosemary. DELICIOUS. Definitely check this place out. The staff was nice, high energy, and knowledgeable. Highly recommend!!

Stopped by here on my birthday over the weekend and it was wonderful!! The staff was amazing and knowledgeable. The cider was delicious and there were so many great options to choose from! They even let me pick out a free cozy since it was my birthday. I will definitely be making another trip back! :)
Absolutely delicious cider! They have a great variety to try and none of them are bad. If you're a cider fan in Richmond- this is the place to go.
Really great ciders. Wonderful flavor profiles. Friendly Staff and a very cool space.
customer_insights: Buskey Cider is a popular cidery in Richmond known for its delicious and diverse cider offerings. While some patrons miss the food partnership with KoBop, the vibrant atmosphere, friendly staff, and unique options like alcoholic ice cream make it a great spot for casual gatherings and celebrations.
